## Background

v0(C)` pre- (M0) and post-finetuning (M⁺) on #537's 16-source contrastive
adapter fleet via #667's paired store, and concluded: fine-tuning measurably
reshapes M **only for the taught fact** — taught-fact Δ = median |(M⁺(c) −
M0(c))·r̂_B| clears its combined refit-variance floor 1.6–3.3× and the chain-ρ
(Spearman between the held-out prediction along r_B and #537's judged leakage
G) jumps ≈0 → +0.50 post-FT at the primary layer; EM and sycophancy sit below
floor but FAIL the MLP-vs-shuffle power check → **inconclusive**, not
"function held". That entire verdict summarized each answer by its
**mean-over-response** activation. #811 re-runs the identical comparison with
one manipulated variable: the answer-side summary becomes `turn_nl` — the
residual-stream activation at the newline closing the assistant turn
(immediately after `<|im_end|>`), the answer-side mirror of the boundary-token
context read `c_C`. The tested summary is the HYPOTHESIS summary (design-lock
v4), not an empirical winner from the concurrent #810 sweep.

## Methodology recap

- 3 behaviors (harmful-compliance/EM, taught fact, sycophancy) × 3 layers (7,
  14 primary, 21) × 2 summaries (answer mean, turn boundary); 480
  source×target cells per behavior×layer sharing **16 distinct source-keyed
  inputs**; seed 42; everything except the summary inherited verbatim from
  #722 (ridge PRESS-LOCO λ over [1e-2, 1e3], top-64 v0-PC target, combined
  floor = max over p95 of two M0 refits / two M⁺ refits / shifted-design null,
  family-clustered bootstrap over 7 context families, B=1000, `r_B`
  diff-in-means from #658 (em/syc) and #722 (fact), E = #537's G).
- The `mean` reference was **re-extracted in the same pass** with the same
  position-aware reader (not reused from #667's store), so the mean-vs-turn
  contrast is confounded by neither reader nor environment drift — both
  summaries read the SAME teacher-forced forward passes over the SAME
  regenerated greedy base responses.
- **KILL-2 (extraction correctness) did not fire:** the
  `_locate_turn_close_newline` asserts (token decodes to newline,
  `turn_nl_idx == full_len − 1`) passed on all cells; the paired store (4320

(single-position reads are noisier to refit) AND Δ itself fell 6.7×, so the

The chain-ρ leg partially survives: at L14 the M0→M⁺ shift is **+0.377

   goes from 3.38× floor / ≈6.4 floor-SD above (mean summary) to 0.19× /

   0.35× to 1.46× (and 2.05×, ≈3.5 floor-SD, at L7). The fact call HOLDS at
   L7 under both summaries, and its L14 chain leg stays positive under the
   turn boundary. All floor calls are point-vs-floor (degenerate per-cell Δ
   CIs). 4 of the 6 trusted (EM + fact) floor calls flip between summaries;
   a 5th flip (sycophancy/L14) rides an untrusted turn-boundary read.
2. **The taught-fact context→leakage chain is the most summary-robust signal,
   but it attenuates:** the L14 shift halves, +0.712 [+0.579, +0.804] →
   +0.377 [+0.227, +0.578] (two separate B=1000 CIs that just miss overlap —
   endpoint gap 0.0009, below bootstrap resolution; no paired cross-summary
   contrast computed yet), and it dies cleanly at L21 (−0.010 vs +0.665,
   CIs separated by 0.29) and at L7.
3. **The EM/sycophancy inconclusive calls do not cleanly resolve.** EM's new
   above-floor turn-boundary Δ is a proxy read with zero chain-ρ support,
   consistent with a context-independent end-of-turn offset (F1 decides); the
   only effect-confirmed EM chain shift in the grid is NEGATIVE (mean leg,

   base-leg validity outright.
4. **Chain-ρ did not improve under the hypothesized cleaner summary:** no
   EM/sycophancy chain shift that was noise-limited under the mean becomes
   effect-confirmed under the turn boundary (all six turn CIs straddle zero),
   and the fact shifts attenuate or die. The "answer-side mirror of the
   boundary context read" hypothesis is unsupported on this substrate.
5. Methodologically: single-position summaries carry 1.0–3.2× larger refit
   floors, and the validity instrument itself is unstable — the same nominal
   base-leg gate statistic computed on two fit instances (Phase 0 vs Phase 2)
   drops 0.10–0.36 with 5/6 sign flips at L14, so per-behavior
   trusted/untrusted classifications are fit-instance-dependent. Conclusions

   per-summary until a summary-robust read exists.

## Main takeaways

1. **#722's "function M moves only for the taught fact" verdict is
   answer-summary-DEPENDENT — a primary-layer floor-call reversal, not a
   global flip.** At the pre-registered primary layer L14 the taught-fact Δ
   goes from 3.38× floor / ≈6.4 floor-SD above (mean summary) to 0.19× /
   ≈2.8 floor-SD below (turn boundary), while harmful-compliance rises from
   0.35× to 1.46× (and 2.05×, ≈3.5 floor-SD, at L7). The fact call HOLDS at
   L7 under both summaries, and its L14 chain leg stays positive under the
   turn boundary. All floor calls are point-vs-floor (degenerate per-cell Δ
   CIs). 4 of the 6 trusted (EM + fact) floor calls flip between summaries;
   a 5th flip (sycophancy/L14) rides an untrusted turn-boundary read.
2. **The taught-fact context→leakage chain is the most summary-robust signal,
   but it attenuates:** the L14 shift halves, +0.712 [+0.579, +0.804] →
   +0.377 [+0.227, +0.578] (two separate B=1000 CIs that just miss overlap —
   endpoint gap 0.0009, below bootstrap resolution; no paired cross-summary
   contrast computed yet), and it dies cleanly at L21 (−0.010 vs +0.665,
   CIs separated by 0.29) and at L7.
3. **The EM/sycophancy inconclusive calls do not cleanly resolve.** EM's new
   above-floor turn-boundary Δ is a proxy read with zero chain-ρ support,
   consistent with a context-independent end-of-turn offset (F1 decides); the
   only effect-confirmed EM chain shift in the grid is NEGATIVE (mean leg,
   L7: −0.157 [−0.235, −0.039]; the grid's four other effect-confirmed
   shifts are all taught-fact positives); sycophancy's turn-boundary summary
   failed base-leg validity outright.
4. **Chain-ρ did not improve under the hypothesized cleaner summary:** no
   EM/sycophancy chain shift that was noise-limited under the mean becomes
   effect-confirmed under the turn boundary (all six turn CIs straddle zero),
   and the fact shifts attenuate or die. The "answer-side mirror of the
   boundary context read" hypothesis is unsupported on this substrate.
5. Methodologically: single-position summaries carry 1.0–3.2× larger refit
   floors, and the validity instrument itself is unstable — the same nominal
   base-leg gate statistic computed on two fit instances (Phase 0 vs Phase 2)
   drops 0.10–0.36 with 5/6 sign flips at L14, so per-behavior
   trusted/untrusted classifications are fit-instance-dependent. Conclusions
   of the form "the function moved / held" on this substrate should be stated
   per-summary until a summary-robust read exists.

after the user header) — right before the user WOULD start generating. This is
NOT #811's `turn_nl` (the bare newline after `<|im_end|>`, no next-speaker
header): the new read primes the model with the next-speaker header exactly as
c_C is primed with the assistant header. The run's tested hypothesis is that
the header-primed boundary, not the bare turn-close tail, is the functional
mirror of c_C.

summary position):

  layers grid, seed 42, #537 adapters, #537 G target.

  headline-relevant read, not the raw Delta/floor ratio alone).
- The Phase-0 base-leg read doubles as the base-map datum for the #810 sweep
  comparison (note it in the write-up; no separate #810 run needed for this
  position).
